CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: I have taken refuge in Jehovah. How can you say to me: "Flee to your mountain like a bird?«
Wicked people bend their bows. They set their arrows against the strings to shoot in the dark at people who are upright in heart.
What can a righteous person do when the foundations of life are destroyed?
Jehovah is in his holy temple. Jehovahs throne is in heaven. His eyes see. They examine the sons of men.
Jehovah tests righteous and wicked people alike. He hates wicked people and the ones who love violence.
He rains down fire and burning sulfur upon wicked people. He makes them drink from a cup filled with scorching wind.
Jehovah is righteous. He loves a righteous way of life. Upright people will see his face .
